item.title: Ep 2 · Domī labōrō · Latin only × 3
item.description: Working from home: getting up late, the kids after school, a client meeting tomorrow. Home or the city: which is better? Quotes: Festīnā lentē (Augustus), Venīte ad mē omnēs quī labōrātis (Matthew 11:28), Carpe diem (Horace, Odes 1.11). Latin only. The whole dialogue 3 times.
